open_points.subject: create-project retry after the created project is corrected
open_points.text: a retried create never makes a second project while the first keeps its values
open_points.question: What must Registry do when the same create request is retried after the active project made by the first request has had one or more values corrected?
options: Recognise the request and return the existing project with its current corrected values.
Refuse the retry because the existing project no longer has the values supplied by the create request.
Treat it as a new create and mint a second project.
open_points.default_guess: Recognise the request and return the existing project with its current corrected values, without reverting it or creating another project.

witness.initial: An active project P was created from request id R with name N1 and object O1; the create answer was lost.
events: The owner finds P through the catalogue and corrects its name to N2.
The owner retries the original create request R carrying N1 and O1.
outcomes: Registry recognises R and returns P with its current name N2; no second project is created.
Because P no longer keeps its original values, Registry treats the retry as a new create and mints project Q with name N1.
witness.observer: The owner sees either one project or two projects in the catalogue.
